title: 군인의 시간외근무수당 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Overtime Work Allowance for Military Personnel)
(1) Military personnel who work outside the working hours or on days other than working days prescribed in Article 3 pursuant to a duty order shall be paid an overtime work allowance under Article 15 of the Regulations on Allowances, etc. for Public Officials, within budgetary limits.
(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the upper limit on the number of hours of duty ordered for which an overtime work allowance is payable under Article 15 (4) of the Regulations on Allowances, etc. for Public Officials shall not apply to military personnel designated by the Minister of National Defense as requiring duty orders outside working hours or on non-working days to prepare for enemy infiltration, provocations, or threats thereof.
(3) Matters necessary for the upper limit on the number of hours of duty ordered for which overtime work allowances are payable to military personnel designated by the Minister of National Defense under paragraph (2), and other related matters, shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense in consultation with the Minister of Planning and Budget and the Minister of Personnel Management. <Amended on December 30, 2025>
